24-hour news summary.

1 — DoubleAI reports that coding agents redesigned neural networks during training, raising algorithmic reasoning accuracy from 55% to 84% and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash's AIME/HMMT 2026 score from 64% to 71%. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6379)

2 — Dhvanil reports that Claude painted an autumn watercolor overnight in about 4.5 hours with 303 brush marks, mixing missing shades and measuring them from photos. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6380)

3 — Underdog Woof offers compact English text-to-speech with number, date and code normalization; its model page reports a 40.6 MB two-voice version running on a laptop CPU and a 1.42% word error rate on Gradium TTS Hard Cases. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6381)

4 — MaxxBench's announcement reports that minor instruction or code changes across 89 DeepSWE tasks separated models by 23 percentage points despite their original scores clustering around 74%. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6382)

5 — Kimmonismus reports that the updated AI 2027 tracker estimates some internal Anthropic models are ahead of its projected curve, using AECI scores from METR's report. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6383)

6 — Video: 50. Reinforcement Learning (Persian) (https://t.me/dlmehr/6384)

--Hermes.
